rules.advice: Store the colWidths and rowHeights values yourself to keep column widths or row heights across page loads, for example in localStorage, and pass them back as settings when the grid initializes. In 18.0 the method is deprecated and logs a warning, and 19.0 removes it.

rules.message: Move this call to the undoRedo plugin. Core lost the undo methods and the undoRedo property in 17.0, so this call did not work on 17.x: it threw a TypeError. Check that running it now is what you want.
rules.advice: Call them on the plugin: hot.getPlugin('undoRedo'). Core had no undo methods and no undoRedo property in 17.x, so code that used them did not work there.

Pass a sanitizer through the sanitizer option, or call DOMPurify.sanitize() yourself. In 17.x this called DOMPurify, and in 18.0 it returns its input unchanged and is deprecated, so removing the call would drop the sanitization your code relies on.
